definition: A method from cooperative game theory adapted to machine learning to fairly attribute a model's prediction to the contribution of each individual input feature.
details: Shapley values (as used in tools like SHAP) provide a theoretically grounded way to explain individual model predictions by quantifying how much each feature contributed relative to a baseline.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. It is the habit of asking, before every launch, what could go wrong — and then doing something about it. Think of it as the quiet rule that a tool should be useful without being dangerous. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” That deliberate caution is Shapley Values.

citation.title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions
